evidence.reason: `deletedAtHead` compares the raw `git ls-tree --name-only` output against the normalized relative path. Git C-quotes unusual pathnames by default (`core.quotePath`), so tracked deletions whose names contain non-ASCII bytes, tabs, quotes, or newlines produce quoted output that never equals `rel`; the function then incorrectly rejects a valid deletion. Using `-z` and splitting on NUL avoids the quoting issue.
